tasks.title: Meeting Minutes Automation
tasks.summary: Automate the flow of subcontractor meeting notes from Otter.ai into Procore, with human review before distribution.

steps.details: After subcontractor meeting ends, Otter generates transcription report. Extract meeting minute notes.
Transform raw transcript into structured meeting minutes. Must read as human-written, not automated.
Enter formatted notes into the specific project and specific meeting record in Procore. Fill out each category of meeting minutes.
Do NOT auto-submit. Send notification that minutes are ready for review.
Manual review step. Terry checks that notes look human-written and accurate.
After approval, distribute to all parties via Procore.

open_questions: How to extract notes from Otter - API, web scrape, or email export?
Procore meeting minute categories and field mapping needed

tasks.title: Schedule Update & Subcontractor Distribution
tasks.summary: After project team meetings, update the internal schedule with current week's progress, distribute to all subs, and send individualized follow-up emails to each subcontractor with their specific tasks.

steps.action: Update internal schedule with current week progress
steps.details: Based on project team meeting outcomes, update schedule to reflect actual progress.

steps.action: Distribute updated schedule to all subcontractors
steps.details: Send the updated schedule to all subs on the project.
Each subcontractor gets a personalized email with their specific tasks from the updated schedule.
